bodh-p01-v01.speaker: Kṣemarāja (invoking voice)
bodh-p01-v01.question: Who is saluted first?
premises: Oṃ. Salutation to Netra; salutation to Śiva constantly — five-act maker, supreme-self-bliss manifest.
bodh-p01-v01.inference: Invocation double: Netra, then five-act Śiva.
uncertainties: Netra (Lord of the eye?) kept as name; five-act formula anticipates sūtra 10.

bodh-p01-v02.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v02.question: What is free consciousness?
premises: Consciousness free, universe's cause — so called; freedom-formed knower — and powers too she bestows.
bodh-p01-v02.inference: Free cause named; powers bestowed added.

bodh-p01-v03.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v03.question: How does she unfold without leaving ground?
premises: She on own ground by own will for world's unfolding — from varied fit variety, subject-object difference.

bodh-p01-v04.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v04.question: How is variety arranged?
premises: That world's variety stands through object-difference — manifold-variety-yoked, high-low-numbered.
bodh-p01-v04.inference: Variety stands arranged by difference, high to low.

bodh-p01-v05.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v05.question: What does tightening make?
premises: From knowing's tightening comes mind — knower still, great Lord.
Banyan-seed-like, the world-form there — so the wise know.
bodh-p01-v05.inference: Tightening makes mind; banyan-seed images containment.

bodh-p01-v06.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v06.question: When is knowing called mind?
premises: Knowing is the self's pure form — stainless, utterly stainless.
That same, rule-bound, is called mind — knowing.
bodh-p01-v06.inference: Pure knowing rule-bound is called mind.

bodh-p01-v07.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v07.question: How do the wise know mind?
premises: Object-faced, awareness has come to rest in mind.
From tightening-dominant-self, the wise know knowing as mind.
bodh-p01-v07.inference: Rest in mind; wise know mind as knowing.

bodh-p01-v08.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v08.question: How does the knower stand bound?
premises: Māyā's knower, knowing-formed, one with that, abides among embodied beings.
Object-clinging, cut off from true discernment.
bodh-p01-v08.inference: Bound knower described: formed, placed, clinging, cut off.

bodh-p01-v09.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v09.question: What stays ever one?
premises: Ever one, established mind — by kalā, sattva, guṇa and the rest.
By seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count.
bodh-p01-v09.inference: Ever-one mind established by enumerated means.
uncertainties: kalāsattvaguṇādi list kept; pratithaś print kept.

bodh-p01-v10.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p01-v10.question: Where sits freedom?
premises: One, everywhere, pure, awareness-selfed, great Lord.
From mis-knowing that I-ness, freedom sits palm-close.
bodh-p01-v10.inference: Everywhere-Lord stated; palm-close freedom from mis-knowing.

bodh-p02-v11.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v11.question: What tends seven and thirty-six?
premises: Cultivated by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count — he, great Lord: glory-of-release proceeds.
bodh-p02-v11.inference: Tended means, Lord tends, release-glory proceeds.

bodh-p02-v12.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v12.question: Are stages certain?
premises: Its stages — views and the rest, all, no doubt.
Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by own will, so bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-powers.
bodh-p02-v12.inference: Stages doubtless yet made-up, assumed like actor's roles.

bodh-p02-v13.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v13.question: How does the impure shine?
premises: Bliss-spread self, assumed vast views-powers, shines.
From own-power-tightening, in wandering, it gets impure.
bodh-p02-v13.inference: Vast-assumed shines; tightened-power impures in wandering.

bodh-p02-v15.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v15.question: What does the incomplete confess?
premises: Incomplete — 'thus-I-am-incomplete' — by various impurities defiled.
Named māyā-inoffensive-karma'd, all-pervading too, world-Lord.
bodh-p02-v15.inference: Incompleteness confessed, defiled, yet all-pervading Lord.

bodh-p02-v16.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v16.question: Who does the five acts?
premises: All-pervading — as the great god does five acts, so this self too does, power-deluded.
Power-delusion the sole difference.
bodh-p02-v16.inference: As god does five, so self does, power-deluded.

bodh-p02-v17.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v17.question: What is he called?
premises: Capable — from expansion, power-Lord is sung by truth-teachers.
From contraction, contracted, as wanderer is called.

bodh-p02-v18.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v18.question: What does māyā will?
premises: Māyā — form indeed — which, somewhat to perceive intent, should know as made-creation.
Other power — preservation considered; from dissolution withdrawn goddess considered.
bodh-p02-v18.inference: Māyā willing perception; other powers considered.

bodh-p02-v19.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v19.question: What grace in unity?
premises: From dissolution withdrawn goddess — in unity-of-consciousness grace considered.
From manifesting that essence, concealment called.
bodh-p02-v19.inference: Withdrawn goddess graces unity; concealment named of manifesting.

bodh-p02-v20.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p02-v20.question: What jewel from ignorance?
premises: Thus always present five-course, in order known — wish-jewel.
That from ignorance — like wood and clod.
bodh-p02-v20.inference: Present course known as jewel; ignorance wood-clod.

bodh-p03-v21.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v21.question: Who is freed by reflection?
premises: By true-reflection-power thus, always, who practices — freed from all bonds, bliss-full, becomes.

bodh-p03-v22.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v22.question: What does the fire swallow?
premises: Fire swallows that — this, well-awake, it is.
When that, then-that, pure, to-be-known — all-devouring fire.
bodh-p03-v22.inference: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.

bodh-p03-v23.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v23.question: What does the joined yogi attain?
premises: By this power joined, freedom-marked, the yogi attains pure state.
That soon — no doubt here.

bodh-p03-v24.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v24.question: What shines when power grows?
premises: Fire, on power grown, even universe shines knowing-made.
Self-bliss-nectar wave risen breaks outside.
bodh-p03-v24.inference: Grown fire shines; nectar breaks outside.

bodh-p03-v25.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v25.question: What plays in quiescence?
premises: That gone to quiescence, by forms shown — self plays, Lord supreme.

bodh-p03-v26.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v26.question: Who frees whom?
premises: Who knows always — freed, frees multitudes too, in a flash, from terrible bondage.
bodh-p03-v26.inference: Knower freed frees scores in a flash.

bodh-p03-v27.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v27.question: Who stands bliss-powered?
premises: Who — someone bliss-powered — established in own state.
Thus whose exultant-rising joy ... (text as printed; iti bridges).
uncertainties: iti bridge kept; exultant-rising compound unexpanded.

bodh-p03-v28.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v28.question: What is desired even in distraction?
premises: His, fixed-in-own-nature — in distraction even — that desired.
This by effort-power by people is attained.
bodh-p03-v28.inference: Desired in distraction; effort-attained by people.

bodh-p03-v29.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v29.question: What shines from the middle's opening?
premises: From middle-center opening, and from bliss-consciousness, shines.
From its light, divine vision of form-knowledge manifested.

bodh-p03-v30.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p03-v30.question: What expands bodiless?
premises: Immaculate, radiant, pure, bliss-full, supreme — and body-cutting-netted too —
Knowledge-vision expands.

bodh-p04-v31.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v31.question: What is the means?
premises: In middle-center opening — but means: powerful state, thought-decay-tightening-opening and the rest, in many ways.
bodh-p04-v31.inference: Middle-opening means: powerful thought-decay state, many ways.

bodh-p04-v32.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v32.question: How do thoughts decay?
premises: From thinking-of-nothing indeed, thoughts' decay may be.
From knowing-awareness, playful power, attached-therein, in being's realm.
bodh-p04-v32.inference: Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; playful power attached in being.

bodh-p04-v33.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v33.question: What do brahma-teachers call tightening?
premises: There-attached, divine stream sees pure-natured; power-tightening — this indeed, it is said by brahma-teachers.
bodh-p04-v33.inference: Attached sees stream; tightening so-called by brahma-teachers.

bodh-p04-v34.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v34.question: What rests listed?
premises: End-beginning-point-rest-bindu-nāda-dwellings, and fear-anger-disgust-graspings.
bodh-p04-v34.inference: Rests listed whole: bindu-nāda and passion-grasps.

bodh-p04-v35.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v35.question: What does the goddess say?
premises: Thus this said: goddess, middle-center-expansion — there capable, in days thus obtains supreme prosperity.
bodh-p04-v35.inference: Goddess speaks expansion; capable obtains prosperity.

bodh-p04-v36.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v36.question: Who wanders reflecting?
premises: Who inner-samādhi-impressed wanders, of pure radiance — by emission-power indeed reflecting, and again, again.
bodh-p04-v36.inference: Impressed wanderer reflects again and again by emission-power.

bodh-p04-v37.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v37.question: What manifests in distraction?
premises: In distraction even — for his own form fully manifests — of the yogi fixed in awareness, of eternal-bliss-essence.

bodh-p04-v38.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v38.question: What strengthens mantra?
premises: That full-of-manifest-bliss, mantra-power-strengthened, full-I-ness knowing — thus of inner-exultation-practitioner.

bodh-p04-v39.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v39.question: Where is the yogi situated?
premises: There-that sporting yogi, in mantra-lord-status situated — there capable lord, as plays power-expanded.
bodh-p04-v39.inference: Sporting yogi mantra-situated, capable playing power-expanded.

bodh-p04-v40.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p04-v40.question: What stays unbroken?
premises: Thus freedom — his, all-pervading, world-Lord's, various-difference-enjoying — unbroken in wondrous state.

bodh-p05-v41.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bodh-p05-v41.question: Who drinks and is quenched?
premises: This non-dual thus said — nectar-of-knowledge unsurpassed — who may drink is quenched.
His saṃsāra-poison-fever.

bodh-p05-v42.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice, colophon-adjacent)
bodh-p05-v42.question: Whose treatise for Śiva's attaining?
premises: This bliss-of-awareness-method for Śiva-attaining — of great souls, of king Kṣema-named — treatise extremely pure. (Colophon third-person excluded.)
uncertainties: Colophon excluded (third-person scribal); rājñaḥ kept in-verse.

bodh-p01-v01.plain_english: Oṃ. Salutation to Netra. Salutation to Śiva constantly — maker of the five acts, manifest as supreme-self bliss.
bodh-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: oṃ namo netrāya | namaḥ śivāya satataṃ pañcakṛtyavidhāyine

bodh-p01-v02.plain_english: Consciousness is free, the universe's cause — so called; freedom-formed, the knower — and powers too she bestows.
bodh-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: citiḥ svatantrā viśvasya hetur ity abhidhīyate | svātantryarūpā jñātā ca siddhīr vā saṃprayacchate

bodh-p01-v03.plain_english: She — on her own ground, by her own will, for the world's unfolding — from varied fit variety, from subject-object difference.
bodh-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: sā svabhittau svecchayaiva viśvasyonmīlanāya | nānānurūpavaicitryād grāhyagrāhakabhedataḥ

bodh-p01-v04.plain_english: That world's variety stands through object-difference — manifold-variety-yoked, high-and-low-numbered.
bodh-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: viśvasya tasya vaicitryaṃ grāhyabhedena saṃsthitam | nānāvaicitryayogena cottamādhamasaṅkhyayā

bodh-p01-v05.plain_english: From consciousness-tightening comes mind — though knower, even the great Lord. Like a banyan seed, there the world-form — that the wise know.
bodh-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: citisaṅkocanāc cittaṃ cetano 'pi maheśvaraḥ | vaṭadhanikāvat tatra viśvarūpaṃ ca tad viduḥ

bodh-p01-v06.plain_english: Knowing is the self's pure form — stainless, utterly stainless. That same, rule-bound, is called mind — knowing.
bodh-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: caitanyam ātmano rūpaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam | tad eva niyamāsaktaṃ cittaṃ cid abhidhīyate

bodh-p01-v07.plain_english: Object-faced, awareness has come to rest in mind. From tightening-dominant-self, the wise know knowing as mind.
bodh-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: arthonmukhatayā saṃvic citte viśrāntim āgatā | saṅkocātmapradhānatvāc citiś cittaṃ vidur budhāḥ

bodh-p01-v08.plain_english: The māyā-knower, knowing-formed, one with that, abides among embodied beings — clinging to objects, void of true discernment.
bodh-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: māyāpramātā cidrūpas tanmayatvena dehinām | vartate viṣayāsaktaḥ sadvivekavivarjitaḥ

bodh-p01-v09.plain_english: Ever one, the established mind — by kalā, sattva, guṇa and the rest, by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count.
bodh-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: sadaikaḥ pratithaś cittaṃ kalāsattvaguṇādibhiḥ | saptapramatṛkatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā

bodh-p01-v10.plain_english: One, everywhere, pure, awareness-selfed, the great Lord. From mis-knowing that I-ness, freedom sits in the palm.
bodh-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: ekaḥ sarvagataḥ śuddhaḥ sambodhātmā maheśvaraḥ | saivāhantāparijñānān muktiḥ karatale sthitā

bodh-p02-v11.plain_english: Cultivated by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count — he, the great Lord: glory-of-release proceeds.
bodh-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ | sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate

bodh-p02-v12.plain_english: Its stages — views and the rest, all of them, no doubt. Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by his own will, so the bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-and-powers.
bodh-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā

bodh-p02-v13.plain_english: Bliss-spread self, having assumed vast views-and-powers, shines. From tightening of own power, in wandering, it becomes impure.

bodh-p02-v15.plain_english: Incomplete — 'thus am I incomplete' — by various impurities defiled; named of-māyā-inoffensive-karma; all-pervading too, world-Lord.
bodh-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: apūrṇo 'smīti vividhair malaiḥ | māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ

bodh-p02-v16.plain_english: All-pervading — just as the great god does five acts, so this self too does — deluded by power.
bodh-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām | tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ

bodh-p02-v17.plain_english: Capable — from expansion, power-Lord is sung by truth-teachers. From contraction, contracted, as wanderer is called.
bodh-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: śakto vikāsāc chaktīśo gīyate tattvavādibhiḥ | saṅkocanāt saṅkocitaḥ saṃsārīty abhidhīyate

bodh-p02-v18.plain_english: Māyā — form indeed — which, somewhat intent to perceive, should know as made-creation. The other power — preservation is considered; from dissolution, the withdrawn goddess is considered.
bodh-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: māyā rūpaṃ hi yat kiṃcid ālokayitum udyatā | anyā śaktiḥ sthitir matā

bodh-p02-v19.plain_english: From dissolution, the withdrawn goddess — in unity-of-consciousness, grace is considered. From manifesting that essence, concealment is called.

bodh-p02-v20.plain_english: Thus always present five-course, in order known — wish-jewel. That from ignorance — like wood and clod.
bodh-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sadā saṃnihitaḥ pañcavāhavidhiḥ | cintāmaṇir asāv ajñānāt kāṣṭaloṣṭavat

bodh-p03-v21.plain_english: By power of true reflection thus, always, who practices — he, liberated from all bonds, full of eternal bliss, becomes.
bodh-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate | sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet

bodh-p03-v22.plain_english: Consciousness-fire swallows that — this, well-awakened, is. When that, then-that, pure, to-be-known — consciousness-fire, all-devouring.

bodh-p03-v23.plain_english: By this power united, liberation-marked yogi attains the pure state. That soon — no doubt here.
bodh-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ | padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so

bodh-p03-v24.plain_english: Consciousness-fire, on gaining power, even the universe shines — consciousness-made. Self-bliss-nectar wave, this risen, outside.

bodh-p03-v25.plain_english: That indeed gone to quiescence, by being-forms manifested — own self, great Lord, god plays, supreme Lord.
bodh-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate | svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ

bodh-p03-v26.plain_english: Thus who constantly knows — he, liberated, liberates too the multitude of beings, in an instant, from terrible saṃsāra-bondage.
bodh-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto mocayaty | api sattvavrātaṃ kṣaṇenaiva ghorāt saṃsārabandhanāt

bodh-p03-v27.plain_english: Who — someone bliss-powered — established in own state. Thus — whose exultant-rising joy ...
bodh-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ kaścit ānandabalaḥ sa svarūpapadasthitaḥ | iti yasya samullāsollāsitodayaśālinaḥ

bodh-p03-v28.plain_english: His, fixed-in-own-nature — in distraction even — that is desired. This by effort-power by people is attained.

bodh-p03-v29.plain_english: From middle-center expansion, and from bliss-consciousness, shines. From its light, divine vision of form-knowledge is manifested.
bodh-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāsāc ca cidānandāt prakāśate | tatprakāśād divyadṛṣṭir jñānarūpā vibhāvyate

bodh-p03-v30.plain_english: Immaculate, radiant, pure, full-of-eternal-bliss, supreme — and-net-of-body-cutting too — knowledge-vision expands.
bodh-p03-v30.sanskrit_cite: nirmalā suprabhā śuddhā nityānandamayī parā | nirdehacchedajālāpi jñānadṛṣṭir vijṛmbhate

bodh-p04-v31.plain_english: In middle-center expansion — but the means: powerful state, thought-decay-tightening-opening and the rest, in many ways.
bodh-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ | vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ

bodh-p04-v32.plain_english: From thinking-of-nothing indeed, thoughts' decay may be. From knowing-awareness, playful power, attached-therein, in being's realm.
bodh-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet | cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale

bodh-p04-v33.plain_english: There-attached, the divine stream sees the pure-natured; power-tightening — this indeed, it is said by brahma-teachers.
bodh-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: tatrānuraktā divyaughaṃ paśyate vimalātmakam | śaktisaṅkocam etad dhi procyate brahmavādibhiḥ

bodh-p04-v35.plain_english: Thus this said: goddess, middle-center-expansion — there capable, in days thus obtains supreme prosperity.
bodh-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi madhyadhāmavikāsakam | tatra śakto dinair evaṃ prapnoti parasampadam

bodh-p04-v36.plain_english: Who inner-samādhi-impressed wanders, of pure radiance — by emission-power indeed reflecting, and again, again.
bodh-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: yo 'ntaḥsamādhisaṃskāraṃ bhramate vimalatviṣām | sa visargabalād eva vimṛśya ca punaḥ punaḥ

bodh-p04-v37.plain_english: In distraction even — for his own form fully manifests — of the yogi fixed in awareness, of eternal-bliss-essence.
bodh-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: vyutthāne 'pi yatas tasya svarūpaṃ samprakāśate | yogino bodhaniṣṭhasya nityānandarasasya ca

bodh-p04-v38.plain_english: That full-of-manifest-bliss, mantra-power-strengthened, full-I-ness knowing — thus of inner-exultation-practitioner.
bodh-p04-v38.sanskrit_cite: tat prakāśānandamayī mantravīryopabṛṃhitā | pūṛnāhantācid ity antaḥsamullāsābhiyoginaḥ

bodh-p04-v39.plain_english: There-that sporting yogi, in mantra-lord-status situated — there capable lord, as plays power-expanded.
bodh-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: tatrāsau vilasan yogī mantreśvarapade sthitaḥ | tatra śakto vibhur yadvat krīḍate śaktibṛṃhitaḥ

bodh-p04-v40.plain_english: Thus freedom — his, all-pervading, world-Lord's, various-difference-enjoying — unbroken in wondrous state.
bodh-p04-v40.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svatantratā tasya vyāpakasya jagadvibhoḥ | nānābhedajuṣaś citrapadasthitasyākhaṇḍitā

bodh-p05-v41.plain_english: This non-dual thus said — nectar-of-knowledge unsurpassed — who may drink is quenched. His fever-of-saṃsāra-poison.
bodh-p05-v41.sanskrit_cite: etad advayam ity uktaṃ jñānāmṛtam anuttamam | yaḥ pibec chāmyate tasya saṃsāraviṣamūrchanam

bodh-p05-v42.plain_english: This bliss-of-awareness-method for attaining Śiva — of great souls, of king Kṣema-named — treatise extremely pure.
bodh-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: bodhollāsavidhāneyaṃ śivaprāpyai mahātmanām | rājñaḥ kṣemābhidhānasya śāstram atyantanirmalam

essence: Tightening makes mind; banyan-seed contains world-form.
Awareness rests object-faced; wise know mind-as-knowing.
Everywhere pure Lord; palm-close freedom via mis-knowing.

sections.SUMMARY: Oṃ to Netra; constant salute to five-act Śiva, supreme-self bliss manifest. Consciousness free, world's cause so-called; knower freedom-formed, powers bestowed. Own ground, own will, world's unfolding; fit variety divides seer-seen. World's variety stands by object-difference, manifold-yoked high-low-numbered. Tightened knowing becomes mind, knower still; banyan-seed holds world-form, wise-known. Self's stainless knowing, rule-bound, named mind-knowing. Object-faced awareness rests in mind; the wise know mind as knowing. Knower knowing-formed abides embodied, clinging, discernment-void. Mind ever-one established through listed means and counts. Lord everywhere-pure; mis-knowing I-ness brings freedom palm-close.

rasa.dominant: maṅgala-bhakti of invocation; vīra of free cause; adbhuta of unborrowing unfolding; adbhuta of arranged variety; adbhuta of knower-tightened; śānta of stainless naming; śānta of rested awareness; karuṇa of bound knower; vīra of established oneness; adbhuta of palm-close freedom
rasa.sthayibhava: praṇaya (love-address) in double salute; utsāha at cause named and bestowing; vismaya at ground-will-purpose; vismaya at high-low numbering; vismaya at mind yet knower; śama at rule-bound name; śama at wise knowing; karuṇā at formed-yet-void; utsāha at means-enumerated oneness; vismaya at mis-knowing bearing freedom
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love-address: Oṃ, salute, salute. Invoking relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: free, cause, bestowing. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: own ground, own will, divided fitness. Unfolding relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: difference arranging high-low. Arrangement relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: tightened yet knower, seed-contained. Tightening relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: stainless, bound, still knowing. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: rested, known by wise. Knowing relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion: knowing-shaped, discernment-void. Binding beheld. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: ever-one, means-counted. Establishment relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: mis-known, palm-close. Nearness relished.

essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.

sections.SUMMARY: By seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count cultivated: the great Lord tends, release-glory proceeds. Stages doubtless yet made-up, actor-assumed by will. Vast-assumed shining; own-power-tightened impurity in wandering. Incompleteness confessed in impurities' words; Lordship kept all-pervading. Five acts mirrored god-to-self; delusion sole difference. Capable sung of expansion; contracted called wanderer of contraction. Willing glimpse, knowing made-making; keeping and withdrawn-loosing deemed. Withdrawn goddess graces oneness; essence-showing named concealment. Ever-present course known as jewel; unknowing timber-clod.

essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.

sections.SUMMARY: Who walks by true reflection's power always is freed of all bonds, bliss-full. Fire swallows, well-awake; all-devouring to be known when pure. United by this power, freedom-marked attains purity soon, doubtless. Power grown, universe shines knowing-made; nectar-wave outward. Gone still, form-shown: self plays Lord supreme. Always-knowing frees; freed frees scores instantly. Bliss-powered established; rising-joy-thus bridges onward. Fixed-nature desired even distracted; effort-power attains. Middle opened, bliss-knowing shines; divine vision manifested. Immaculate ranks expand bodiless knowing-vision.

essence: Middle-opening means powerful thought-decay, many ways.
Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; play-power enamoured in being.
Attached sees bright flood; tightening brahma-called.
Goddess speaks; strong win reward in days.
Impressed roamer reflects again and again.
Sporting yogi mantra-stayed, strong playing power-swollen.

Samādhi-impressed roams pure-rayed, reflecting by emission-power doubled. Even distracted, own form shines for awareness-fixed bliss-essenced yogi. Bliss-manifest mantra-strong full-I-knowing: inward devotee's. Sporting stayed mantra-situated; strong playing power-expanded. Freedom his, everywhere, world-Lord's, difference-tasting, wonder-state-unbroken.

lines: Oṃ — bow to Netra. Bow to Śiva, always —
five-act maker, supreme-self bliss made plain.
bodh-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: oṃ namo netrāya | namaḥ śivāya satataṃ pañcakṛtyavidhāyine

lines: Free stands knowing — the world's cause, so called;
freedom-formed knower — and powers bestowed.
bodh-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: citiḥ svatantrā viśvasya hetur ity abhidhīyate | svātantryarūpā jñātā ca siddhīr vā saṃprayacchate

lines: She, on her own ground, by her own will — for worlds unfolding;
from fit variety, from seer-seen division.
bodh-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: sā svabhittau svecchayaiva viśvasyonmīlanāya | nānānurūpavaicitryād grāhyagrāhakabhedataḥ

lines: This world's variety stands on object-difference;
manifold-yoked, high and low in number.
bodh-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: viśvasya tasya vaicitryaṃ grāhyabhedena saṃsthitam | nānāvaicitryayogena cottamādhamasaṅkhyayā

lines: From knowing tightened, mind — knower still, great Lord;
banyan-seed-like, the world-form there — so the wise know.
bodh-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: citisaṅkocanāc cittaṃ cetano 'pi maheśvaraḥ | vaṭadhanikāvat tatra viśvarūpaṃ ca tad viduḥ

lines: Knowing, the self's pure stainless form —
that same, rule-bound, is called mind.
bodh-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: caitanyam ātmano rūpaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam | tad eva niyamāsaktaṃ cittaṃ cid abhidhīyate

lines: Object-turned, awareness rests in mind;
from tightening-rule the wise know mind as knowing.
bodh-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: arthonmukhatayā saṃvic citte viśrāntim āgatā | saṅkocātmapradhānatvāc citiś cittaṃ vidur budhāḥ

lines: Māyā's knower, knowing-shaped, one with that, abides —
object-clinging, cut from true discernment.
bodh-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: māyāpramātā cidrūpas tanmayatvena dehinām | vartate viṣayāsaktaḥ sadvivekavivarjitaḥ

lines: Ever one, mind established — by kalā, sattva-strand, and the rest,
by seven knowers, by thirty-six in count.
bodh-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: sadaikaḥ pratithaś cittaṃ kalāsattvaguṇādibhiḥ | saptapramatṛkatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā

lines: One, everywhere, pure, awareness itself, great Lord —
mis-know that I-ness, and freedom sits palm-close.
bodh-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: ekaḥ sarvagataḥ śuddhaḥ sambodhātmā maheśvaraḥ | saivāhantāparijñānān muktiḥ karatale sthitā

lines: Tended by seven knowers, by thirty-six in count —
he, great Lord: freedom's glory proceeds.
bodh-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ | sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate

lines: Its stages — views and the rest, all, no doubt;
made-up stages: as an actor takes his part by will, so bliss-spread self takes vast views-powers.
bodh-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā

lines: Bliss-spread self, vast views-powers assumed, shines;
tightened own power in wandering — impure it grows.
Incomplete — 'so I am, incomplete' — by assorted stains defiled,
māyā's, atom's, deed's by name — yet all-pervading too, world-Lord.
bodh-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: apūrṇo 'smīti vividhair malaiḥ | māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ

lines: All-pervading — as great god does five, so this self does too —
power-deluded the only difference.
bodh-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām | tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ

lines: Strong from expanse — power-Lord sung by truth-tellers;
tightened from tightening — called wanderer.
bodh-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: śakto vikāsāc chaktīśo gīyate tattvavādibhiḥ | saṅkocanāt saṅkocitaḥ saṃsārīty abhidhīyate

lines: Māyā — form indeed — bent to glimpse a little, know made-making;
other power — keeping deemed; from loosing, withdrawn goddess deemed.
bodh-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: māyā rūpaṃ hi yat kiṃcid ālokayitum udyatā | anyā śaktiḥ sthitir matā

lines: Loosed away, withdrawn goddess — in knowing-oneness, grace deemed;
showing that essence — veiling named.
Thus ever near, five-coursed, known in order — wish-jewel;
that, from unknowing — like timber and clods.
bodh-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sadā saṃnihitaḥ pañcavāhavidhiḥ | cintāmaṇir asāv ajñānāt kāṣṭaloṣṭavat

lines: By true reflection's power, always, who walks —
freed from every bond, full of endless bliss, becomes.
bodh-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate | sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet

lines: Knowing-fire swallows that — this, well awake, it is;
when that, then that, pure, to-be-known — fire all-devouring.
By this power joined, marked with freedom — the yogi attains
the pure state. That, soon — here no doubt.
bodh-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ | padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so

lines: Knowing-fire, grown in power — even the world shines, knowing-made;
self-bliss nectar-wave, risen, breaks outside.
That, to stillness gone, shown by being-forms —
own self, great Lord, god at play, supreme Lord.
bodh-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate | svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ

lines: Who knows always — freed, frees others too, beings by the score,
in a flash, from terrible bondage.
bodh-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto mocayaty | api sattvavrātaṃ kṣaṇenaiva ghorāt saṃsārabandhanāt

lines: Who — some bliss-powered one — standing in own state —
thus, whose rising joy exults ... .
bodh-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ kaścit ānandabalaḥ sa svarūpapadasthitaḥ | iti yasya samullāsollāsitodayaśālinaḥ

lines: His, nature-fixed — in distraction even — that is desired;
this, by effort's power, by people is attained.
From the middle's opening — and from bliss-knowing — it shines;
from its light, divine vision, knowledge-formed, is shown.
bodh-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāsāc ca cidānandāt prakāśate | tatprakāśād divyadṛṣṭir jñānarūpā vibhāvyate

lines: Spotless, radiant, pure, bliss-full, supreme — bodiless-netted too —
knowing-vision expands.
bodh-p03-v30.sanskrit_cite: nirmalā suprabhā śuddhā nityānandamayī parā | nirdehacchedajālāpi jñānadṛṣṭir vijṛmbhate

lines: In the middle's opening — yet the means: a powerful stand,
thoughts decaying, tightening, opening, and the rest, in many ways.
bodh-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ | vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ

lines: From thinking nothing, thoughts decay — so may it be;
from knowing-awareness, play-power, enamoured there, in being's field.
bodh-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet | cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale

lines: Fixed there, the bright flood sees the pure in nature;
power's tightening — fie, so say the brahma-teachers.
bodh-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: tatrānuraktā divyaughaṃ paśyate vimalātmakam | śaktisaṅkocam etad dhi procyate brahmavādibhiḥ

lines: Point-rests at end and start — bindu, nāda — and grasps
of dread, fear, anger, loathing.
'Thus,' she said: goddess, middle's opening —
there the strong in days thus win supreme reward.
bodh-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi madhyadhāmavikāsakam | tatra śakto dinair evaṃ prapnoti parasampadam

lines: Who roams impressed with inner samādhi, pure-rayed —
by emission-power reflecting — again, and again.
bodh-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: yo 'ntaḥsamādhisaṃskāraṃ bhramate vimalatviṣām | sa visargabalād eva vimṛśya ca punaḥ punaḥ

lines: In distraction even — his own form fully shines —
the yogi's, awareness-fixed, eternal-bliss-essenced.
bodh-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: vyutthāne 'pi yatas tasya svarūpaṃ samprakāśate | yogino bodhaniṣṭhasya nityānandarasasya ca

lines: That — bliss-made-manifest, mantra-strong, full-I knowing —
so, of the inward-exulting devotee.
bodh-p04-v38.sanskrit_cite: tat prakāśānandamayī mantravīryopabṛṃhitā | pūṛnāhantācid ity antaḥsamullāsābhiyoginaḥ

lines: There — that sporting yogi, mantra-Lord-status stayed —
there strong, a lord, as he plays, power-swollen.
bodh-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: tatrāsau vilasan yogī mantreśvarapade sthitaḥ | tatra śakto vibhur yadvat krīḍate śaktibṛṃhitaḥ

lines: Thus freedom — his, everywhere-going, world-Lord's, tasting all difference —
unbroken in the wonder-state.
bodh-p04-v40.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svatantratā tasya vyāpakasya jagadvibhoḥ | nānābhedajuṣaś citrapadasthitasyākhaṇḍitā

lines: This non-dual, thus told — knowledge-nectar past compare —
who drinks is quenched: his saṃsāra-poison fever.

lines: This knowing-bliss method for winning Śiva — great souls', Kṣema-named king's —
